name: Island Sweet Skunk
summary: **Island Sweet Skunk** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Federation Seeds]] on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, [[country:CA|Canada]], and first sold in the early 2000s. Its parentage is disputed, with some tracing it to Sweet Skunk stock and Federation describing it as a separate selection from related material. It became one of the seed company's sativa-leaning lines and spread through Pacific Northwest markets.
